category: Application Library examples: Polymer Flow Module
description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the Polymer Flow Module. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: 2D Non-Newtonian Slot-Die Coating [Polymer Flow Module example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the Polymer Flow Module (Tutorials): 2D Non-Newtonian Slot-Die Coating. Physics interfaces: Phase Field (pf), Laminar Flow (spf). Multiphysics couplings: TwoPhaseFlowPhaseField. Study steps: PhaseInitialization, Time Dependent. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
tools.usage: MCP: comsol_run_example("Polymer_Flow_Module/Tutorials/slot_die_coating_2d") to solve it, comsol_example_info("slot_die_coating_2d", include_java=true) for its build script. COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > Polymer Flow Module > Tutorials > slot die coating 2d

parameters.name: pf
parameters.description: physics interface Phase Field (API type PhaseField)

parameters.name: spf
parameters.description: physics interface Laminar Flow (API type LaminarFlow)

tools.notes: Library path Polymer_Flow_Module/Tutorials/slot_die_coating_2d; model file 34.3 MB. Documented Java build script available (rebuild with comsol_run_example method='java'). Requires the module licence to open and solve.
